Nina (AE): Quick sync — customer wants BYOK + HSM-backed CMKs for their prod tenant. Asking for an operational runbook and any pricing delta for HSM-backed keys.
Dante (Solutions Eng): Awesome. Do we have a minimal POC checklist we can give them? They want to try encrypt/decrypt and a rotation test.
Nina (AE): They also called out FIPS 140-2 Level 3 requirement and no key material leaving their VPC.
Rita (Security): FIPS L3 is an ask we can support with partner HSMs (CloudHSM / Thales). Need to confirm architecture: are they expecting on-prem HSM + Redwood Private, or cloud-HSM with customer-managed CMKs?
Nina (AE): Customer preference is cloud-managed HSM inside their AWS account (BYOK), then Redwood gets a grant to use the CMK.
Tom (SRE): For cloud-Hsm BYOK flow we'll need: 1) IAM role ARN to grant; 2) CMK alias + key ID; 3) network peering details for Private deployment if they want no egress. Also maintenance window for rotation.
Dante (Solutions Eng): Drafting a POC runbook — short version below, can someone add security notes?
Dante (Solutions Eng): ```POC runbook:
1) Customer creates CMK in their AWS account (HSM-backed).
2) Customer grants the Redwood service principal: aws:GrantUsage or KMS grants.
3) Create a test S3 object encrypted with CMK, call Redwood encrypt/decrypt via API.
4) Perform a key rotation (create new key version or rotate alias) during agreed maintenance window.
5) Validate request latency and error/fallback to soft-key variant.```
Rita (Security): Add: require CloudTrail logs forwarded + KMS key policy with explicit deny for root deletion. Also request a CMK rotation SLA window (we recommend 30d but they can set 90d).
Nina (AE): Pricing question — they want to know if HSM-backed CMKs add a per-key monthly fee vs just usage-based. What's our standard guidance?
Tom (SRE): For Dedicated/Private deployments there is an ops premium to cover HSM licensing + reserved capacity. For Hosted we pass through HSM costs: approximate extra $X/month per CMK + per-encrypt token usage. I'll pull numbers but flag: SOW will need HSM license line item.
Dante (Solutions Eng): Also note: if they insist on no key material leaving their account we must run Redwood Private in their VPC or on-prem. Our hosted offering uses envelope encryption with keys we manage so not suitable.
Nina (AE): Customer also sent a security questionnaire — section on key rotation, split knowledge, and key escrow. Any templated answers?
Rita (Security): I'll upload standard answers, but quick notes: we support customer-managed keys with key rotation policies, we do not hold escrow copies unless explicitly requested in SOW and protected by KMS/ERP process, and split-knowledge ceremonies are supported for on-prem HSMs.
Nina (AE): Great. Can you confirm expected lead time for doing Private deployment + HSM integration? Customer wants timeline for commercial sign-off.
Tom (SRE): Ballpark: 6-8 weeks for Private + HSM integration (network setup, key ceremony, certs, and validation) assuming they provide AWS account access and security contacts quickly. If they want on-prem HSM it could be 10-12 weeks.
Dante (Solutions Eng): Quick IAM snippet we can give them for the KMS Grant request: ```{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDCATED:role/redwood-service"},
    "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}``` (they should adjust Resource+conditions).
Rita (Security): Also ensure Condition: aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp to lock usage to their network if possible.
Nina (AE): Next steps for AE: share runbook + pricing stub + security answers. Dante/Tom to validate technical bits. Rita to review the questionnaire answers. I'll loop in legal for DPA.
ops-bot: Deployment note: created ticket INF-4512 for HSM pricing estimate and SOW draft.
Dante (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a one-pager POC checklist and attach the example test payloads. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Nina (AE): Perfect — customer asked for a kickoff the week after next. Can we target that?
Tom (SRE): Should be fine if we have IAM + network details from customer by Monday.
Rita (Security): I'll pre-sign answers to the questionnaire items we control and flag any high-risk asks.
Nina (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll send the calendar invite once we have the kickoff agenda items.
Dante (Solutions Eng): One more thing: if they want automatic rotation, confirm whether they want alias rotation (transparent) or re-encrypting stored artifacts. Need decision.
Nina (AE): Noted — I'll ask them to pick alias vs rewrap.
Tom (SRE): FYI: fallback policy for POC — if the CMK call fails we can route to a soft-key non-HSM variant for demo, this will be clearly labeled and not for prod.
Nina (AE): Cool. Closing action: I'll post the runbook + pricing to this thread when ready.
